column1: # The town K-Klimb vocabulary, which nothing has ever put on screen.
# of 301 published lines, and the whole town Klimb vocabulary is in the
# `Klimb--On foot!` have never appeared in a sampled stock frame.
# That matters beyond coverage. `cleak/u5-spec#265` says the town handler's
# complete vocabulary is "`Klimb-`, `-On foot!`, `Up!`, `Down!`, the four
# direction names, `Pass` and `What?`" and that "it has no `Not climbable!`
# literal" - and this engine prints `Not climbable!` there. I declined to
# change that on the answer alone because no scenario could measure it. This
# Measured 2026-09-13: a `k` on ordinary ground leaves ` Klimb-` open on both
# sides and waits, so the town arm does read a further key even though
# `cleak/u5-spec#265` says its up and down arms "are selected by the exact
# tile underfoot". What that key does is the part still unverified, so the
# beats below feed it a direction, the pass key and a letter in turn.
# requires-seed: a save placed beside Britain's fountain

column4: K on ordinary ground: the echo completes itself
